explanation: The English article opens with it: the treaty "was signed on 30 May following the London Conference of 1912–1913" and "dealt with the territorial adjustments arising out of the conclusion of the First Balkan War". Its terms are that settlement. The Ottoman Empire ceded all its territory in Europe west of the Enos–Midia line to the Balkan League, renounced Crete and left the Albanian question to the Great Powers.
